title: Corporate Posting Rates on Checked-Bag Charges
content:
**Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — bag charge terms for Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The list charge of a checked bag is multiplied by the **posting rate**, which follows the agreement the ticket names and its flown-spend postings dated within the last 6 months. The rate acts on the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

| Agreement named on the ticket | Flown-spend postings dated within the last 6 months | Posting rate |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 6 or more (busy posting count) | 0.8 |
| Active | 3 or more (steady posting count) and fewer than 6 | 0.9 |
| Any other ticket | — | 1 |

The flown-spend postings are the spend postings on the agreement's activity record in Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements, counted when dated within the last 6 months; the agreement's status is read from its record.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Agreement status | Postings in the last 6 months | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 6 | 0.8 |
| Active | 5 | 0.9 |
| Active | 3 | 0.9 |
| Active | 2 | 1 |
| Not active | 9 | 1 |
| No agreement | — | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A list charge of 50 dollars at a posting rate of 0.9 becomes 45.00 dollars.
